title: SuperSLM-Unreal - Deterministic Small Language Model Inference inside Unreal Engine 5.8
author: MidSerpent
selftext:
I'm really excited to announce SuperSLM-Unreal; the Unreal Engine 5 integration of my deterministic small language model inference runtime.   
  
SuperSLM was built from the ground up to play nice inside a game engine. The Unreal integration keeps the work off the game thread, running either on background cores or time-sliced on the GPU to cooperate with rendering.   
  
SuperSLM is fully integer based with no floating point math, so it's serializable and returns the same result for the same prompt on different CPUs, GPU's, compliers and platforms.\*    
  
Schema constrained decoding allows you to specify a JSON schema and the result cannot violate the schema. Runtime LORA adapters allow  you to switch between different specializations rapidly without unloading the core model.  
  
Qwen2.5 0.5/1.5b-Instruct are the main models supported for conversion but the engine also supports 3b & 7b as well as Qwen3-Embedding-0.6b (untested on other Qwen3 models.)  
  
Development is ongoing with upcoming features including JSON array type support and pre-computed prefix KV swapping.

\*Certification has been limited to available test hardware, I don't have a Mac to compile and test on Metal.
